title: Risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies
description: Captures known delivery uncertainty, ownership, mitigation, dependencies, assumptions, tracking, and escalation.

questions.prompt: What risks or active issues are already known?
What is the potential impact of each?
Who owns each risk or issue?
What mitigation or immediate response is planned?
Which external teams, systems, approvals, data sources, or decisions does delivery depend on?
Where will risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies be tracked?
When and how should an issue be escalated?
What is the likelihood and severity of each risk?
What contingency plan applies if mitigation fails?
What trigger indicates that contingency action is required?
What is the expected residual risk after mitigation?
How frequently will the risk register be reviewed?
Have similar risks occurred on previous initiatives?
Should the microsite include a risk heat map or scoring model?
